purpose: Keep Codex root as coordinator, verifier, and sole publisher for delegated multi-agent work via a Codex-only user skill until cross-provider child-thread history transfer of Responses encrypted_content is verified safe.
consumer: Codex root coordinator sessions, bounded Kimi CLI and Cursor workers, and operators coordinating external harness work from this dotfiles tree.
contract: Until a fresh regression proves Codex can disable encrypted reasoning state for the worker path or llm-gateway supports exact history transfer without loss (inherited child turns and tool calls), Codex root MUST NOT use Codex subagents for delegated work; it loads the external-harness-orchestration skill and delegates bounded fresh sessions to Kimi CLI or Cursor with ownership packets, no worker VCS/publication authority, coordinator independent verification, and repo-memory continuation. Skill MUST include main-agent-only <SUBAGENT-STOP> telling a bounded subagent to stop and return to Codex root. Concurrency MUST be resource-budgeted and provider-aware (verify host RAM/headroom and provider capacity; fan out only with at least two independent ownership lanes and resources; cap each batch to the smaller of independent lanes, verified provider capacity, conservative host-memory budget, and the operator hard ceilings) inside Mikael's hard ceilings: at most 10 total Kimi agents per Kimi coordinator/swarm including the lead and at most 30 Kimi agents globally. Every external worker launch MUST go through the Codex-only launcher config/codex/bin/codex-external-run.mjs installed only under ~/.codex/bin, which writes a crash-recoverable per-run provenance record under $XDG_STATE_HOME/codex/external-runs (fallback ~/.local/state/codex/external-runs) with 0700/0600 modes, requires explicit root/parent/task identity, reserves the declared Kimi agent budget including the lead, rejects per-coordinator budgets above 10 and global reservations above 30, reconciles stale dead-PID records, rejects duplicate run records and second writers on one workspace, serializes check-and-reserve under an advisory lock, injects ancestry/budget via environment without logging the prompt, and never persists prompt content, command arguments, environment, credentials, or tool output. Canonical skill MUST live at config/codex/skills/external-harness-orchestration with agents/openai.yaml. Home Manager MUST install only that skill at .codex/skills/external-harness-orchestration. AGENTS handwritten section MUST be a minimal load trigger only. General orchestration runbook MUST be absent. scripts/repo-check.sh MUST invoke scripts/test-codex-external-harness-skill.mjs. JCode remains evaluation-only.
failure_boundary: Do not edit the managed Purpose block in config/codex/AGENTS.md, do not touch the dirty canonical ~/.dotfiles checkout, do not commit/land/push/publish/activate Home Manager, do not edit secrets, do not touch live ~/.codex/skills/singularity-engine-forward, and do not grant workers VCS or publication authority. If encrypted_content would be translated, stripped, or sent to an incompatible upstream, fail closed or start an explicitly fresh portable session containing only transferable instructions/transcript. Do not treat docs/runbooks or config/codex/runbooks as the canonical location. The operator hard ceilings (at most 10 Kimi agents per coordinator/swarm including the lead; at most 30 Kimi agents globally) are hard ceilings, not targets; resource, provider, and independent-lane checks must select a lower live count. Do not install the launcher under ~/.agents or global PATH, and do not persist worker prompts, arguments, environment, credentials, or tool output in run records. Do not add JCode as a worker path.
